worldcombat.skill.blizzard.summary: Summon a lingering blizzard on a patch of ground that rakes the whole area again and again: every enemy inside takes Ice damage each rake, is pushed outward, and may be frozen in place, unable to move or act; the longer one target stays in the storm, the less each rake hurts, and the storm itself weakens rake by rake. Step out to be safe. Rain makes it fiercer.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.use.0: Lock down a patch of ground and force enemies off it
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.use.1: Cover a whole cluster of enemies at once
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.use.2: Push radius and freeze chance higher in the rain
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.description.0: Each rake deals one hit to every enemy in the storm, about %1$s special damage on the first rake, for %2$s rakes; each later rake on the same target is about 85%% of the previous one, never below half.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.description.1: Storm radius %1$s blocks, rake interval %2$s, cast distance %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.description.2: Each rake pushes enemies in the storm %1$s blocks outward and has a %2$s chance to freeze them; a frozen target cannot move or use moves for up to about 8 seconds, and fire damage breaks the freeze.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.weather: In rain or a thunderstorm: larger radius, heavier rakes and a higher freeze chance.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.howl.on: Howl mode now: larger radius, more rakes, stronger push and a higher freeze chance, but each rake is lighter and it winds up, recovers and recharges slower.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.howl.off: Concentrated mode now: a smaller radius and heavier rakes that wind up, recover and recharge sooner, but it covers less and rakes fewer times.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.growth.0: From level %1$s each rake rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.growth.1: From level %1$s each rake %2$s and storm radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.preference.ho: On: radius x1.2, +2 rakes, push x1.3 and freeze chance x1.2, but each rake x0.9 and +3 windup / +2 recovery / +8 cooldown. Off: concentrated, radius x0.85 and each rake x1.15, winding up and recovering sooner and recharging faster.
worldcombat.skill.blizzard.preference.ai: The companion only considers Blizzard while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger locks down from further away.
When on, the companion prefers targets with allies packed around them (the storm covers them all at once); off ranks only by range and target health.
How many other enemies within this radius count as a cluster; larger values reward wide-area use, smaller ones only true packs.
